technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with strong short-term momentum (hull flip, AO cross, Ichimoku cross) offset by bearish MACD, overbought Williams %R, and price below 200-EMA; moderate confluence but weak trend structure limits swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 78 days present material risk.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — mixed senior/junior members, moderate amounts
sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity shows modest bipartisan buying with one recent senior sale; lack of news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (448), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinational earnings, CPI event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 78 days creates binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum confluence (Hull flip, AO cross, Ichimoku cross, RSI rising) with extreme fear sentiment (14/100) and contrarian congressional buying creates tactical entry opportunity near support (106.42).
debate.key_bear_argument: Bearish MACD, price below 200-EMA, weak intermediate trend (EMA 20/50 not bullish), negative money flow, VIX crisis (448), flat yield curve recession signal, and 78-day earnings binary event create structural headwinds that overwhelm short-term technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum signals (Hull flip, AO cross, Ichimoku) and extreme fear sentiment (14/100) create tactical appeal, but structural bearish setup (MACD bearish, price below 200-EMA, weak intermediate trend) combined with macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve) and 78-day earnings binary event outweigh entry conviction.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis environment (448) and flat yield curve recession signal create systemic drawdown risk that could invalidate short-term technicals; 78-day earnings event adds uncompensated binary risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
